title: Weekly project sweep
prompt:
Review every project once.
For each project in hq_index: check its repos for commits in the last 7 days (gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/commits?since=...), and read SUMMARY only if something changed. Update stage/health/nextStep with project_update and add one project_log line where there was activity. Flag projects not updated in 14+ days.
Final answer: a 5-10 line week summary.
